utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what’s the repair drive fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Last I heard, they’re starting with the leaky faucets and broken locks first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, that’s the urgent stuff. Do they need any tools or volunteers yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — if the repair drive needs tools, I can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’d be great—thanks, Gus. I might’ve missed a few details, so I’ll let you know what we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem—just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard they’re trying to get a few things fixed up around the block this week. If you want, I can pass along what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be really helpful, thanks. I’m mostly worried about timing and where they’ll be working.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the schedule and the spots they’re starting with. If I catch any updates, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the box of extension cords from my porch and then meet me at the community center around 3?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll grab the box of extension cords from your porch and meet you at the community center around 3.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone about it—want me to bring you along and introduce you to the group?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s kind of you, Quinn. I might come by, but I’d rather keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll keep it low-key. If you decide to come by, I’ll just point you toward the group without making a fuss.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Let’s make sure we know what supplies and help we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help check what tools and supplies we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — that would be a huge help. I’ll make a quick list, and then we can divide up what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I act.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I joined a bit late, but I can help you sort it out. What part of the repair drive do you want to confirm?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the date, time, and location first, plus what items or help are needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to work around school pickup times. What’s the plan for today?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works—we can plan around pickup. I’m thinking we start after lunch and keep the jobs flexible; does 1:30 sound doable?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 1:30 should work for me. I’ll swing by after pickup and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what’s the plan for it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking we keep it simple: a table for sign-ups, a box for parts, and a quick list of what each person can help with.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really practical—I can help keep the sign-up table organized. Want me to spread the word to a few neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Kira, I’m in—just send me the basics for the repair drive and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, can you confirm what basics you need from me? I want to make sure I send the right details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the date, time, meeting spot, and what tools or supplies to bring. Keep it short and I’m good.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—do you know what they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m not totally sure, but I think they still need a few hands for sorting donations and helping folks check in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense—I can help with sorting if they still need people. Do you know when they’re doing check-in?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive plan to a few neighbors and keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep track of the supplies and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll spread the word and circle back once I’ve talked to a few folks.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting underway soon — I’m happy to spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll mention it around the neighborhood and let folks know to keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I knew I was forgetting something. What’s the plan again, Vik?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re still on for the repair drive this Saturday morning — I’m just confirming the tools and the pickup list. I’ll circle back with the exact time once I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — thanks for the reminder, Vik. I’ll be ready Saturday morning and can help with whatever’s on the pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring whatever’s broken or missing by Saturday, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring anything broken or missing by Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — if you need any tools for the repair drive, I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a clear list and let you know what I need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — send it over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll see what I can spare.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—thank you, Mara! I’m putting together a quick list of homes that still need a hand, and I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Quinn—I’ll be ready to jump in once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the latest on what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ve got a few spots still on the list: the loose porch step, the flickering hallway light, and the back gate latch. If you want, I can point you to the one nearest your route.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — point me to the one nearest my route, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can use your help. Want to take a quick look at what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can help with that. Show me what still needs doing and I’ll keep track of the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got a short list: we still need labels, a few extension cords, and someone to confirm the pickup table. I’ll start checking those off with you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a little behind on the repair drive—have you heard what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t heard the full list yet—what do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure, just that they still need a few supplies and probably some extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in — just give me the main details and where to drop stuff off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — the drop-off is at the school parking lot by the gym, Saturday morning. I’ll send the full list of needed items and the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — send the list when you can, and I’ll swing by the school lot Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re really coming, right? I just need to know what you can bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m coming. I can bring a toolbox and some extra screws if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces second-hand—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late to the details, but I heard it’s moving along and they’re still trying to round up more help. If you want, I can check back and tell you what I find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I'm mostly hearing snippets too, so any update would help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal — I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive. What do you need me to help with first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — could you start by checking the community center and the mailbox area for any repair notes or damaged items?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check the community center and the mailbox area now and note anything that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a small list of supplies I can check on for the repair drive. Tell me what you need most, and I’ll see what I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do you mean tools first, or materials like nails and wood? I just want to make sure I’m asking for the right thing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tools first, then materials like nails and wood. If you tell me what job comes first, I can check the right supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together a repair drive this weekend—want me to add you to the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, please add me—I can help out for a bit this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll put you on the list and send the details soon. Glad to have you helping out!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m trying to keep track of the remaining items and who’s bringing what. If you can, could you check which supplies are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the list now and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in. What part do you want to focus on?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — can you help with spreading the word first? I’d like to make sure the details are right before we invite people in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll help get the word out once they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey, I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving. Let’s line up the tasks and make sure everyone knows where to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Rosa. Tell me where you need me and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — could you handle the sign-up sheet and keep track of who’s bringing tools? I’ll coordinate the volunteers and timing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already — seems like folks are bringing tools, spare parts, and plenty of good will. If you’re thinking of pitching in, now’s a great time to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I may stop by with a few things if I can. It’s good to hear people are showing up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s lovely to hear — even a few extra hands or odds and ends can make a big difference. If you do come by, I’m sure they’d be glad to see you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Eli, are you still on for the repair drive? I can bring my toolkit if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I’m still on for it. Let’s meet at the usual time, and your toolkit would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring it and see you at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Just your help spreading the word and showing up if you can — every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that — I’ll spread the word and try to make it if I can.
